nodes.name: euler_coprime_mod_transport
nodes.summary: Balanced congruence transports actual common-divisor coprimality, even at modulus zero or one.

nodes.name: euler_multiplier_coprime_iff
nodes.summary: Multiplication by a coprime multiplier preserves and reflects precisely the unit predicate used by Phi.

nodes.name: euler_modular_unit_coprime
nodes.summary: An actual bounded inverse implies the frozen common-divisor coprimality graph.

nodes.name: euler_coprime_modular_unit
nodes.summary: Above modulus one, coprimality constructs the blueprint's actual bounded inverse without assuming it.

nodes.name: euler_multiplier_residue_exists
nodes.summary: Actual Euclidean division constructs a canonical residue of every multiplied index, including index zero.

nodes.name: euler_multiplier_prefix_empty
nodes.summary: The empty multiplier prefix has no residue obligations.

nodes.name: euler_multiplier_prefix_extend
nodes.summary: Append the actual next canonical residue, preserving every earlier decoded multiplier value.

nodes.name: euler_multiplier_prefix_exists
nodes.summary: HA induction builds the complete beta-coded multiplier prefix; no map or bijection is supplied as a premise.

nodes.name: euler_multiplier_prefix_entry
nodes.summary: Every decoded map entry, not just its construction witness, has the required bound and balanced congruence.

nodes.name: euler_multiplier_prefix_bounded_injective
nodes.summary: Coprime modular cancellation makes the genuinely constructed full multiplier map a bounded injection.

nodes.name: euler_multiplier_prefix_permutation
nodes.summary: The multiplier map has actual bounded, injective, and surjective prefix evidence, not an assumed permutation label.

nodes.name: euler_multiplier_permutation_exists
nodes.summary: Every coprime multiplier at every positive modulus constructs a genuine canonical finite permutation, including modulus one.

nodes.name: euler_unit_product_factor_exists
nodes.summary: Construct the actual weighted factor by the independent decidable coprimality predicate.

nodes.name: euler_unit_product_factor_unit_value
nodes.summary: At a genuine unit index the weighted factor is the index itself.

nodes.name: euler_unit_product_factor_nonunit_value
nodes.summary: A nonunit index contributes exactly one, not a zero or an assumed cancellable residue.

nodes.name: euler_unit_product_factor_coprime
nodes.summary: Every weighted factor is coprime to the modulus, including the modulus-one zero factor.

nodes.name: euler_unit_product_prefix_empty
nodes.summary: The empty weighted-factor prefix is valid for any beta codes.

nodes.name: euler_unit_product_prefix_extend
nodes.summary: Actually append the independently chosen next factor while preserving every earlier factor.

nodes.name: euler_unit_product_prefix_exists
nodes.summary: HA induction constructs all coprime-weighted factors; their list is never an endpoint assumption.

nodes.name: euler_unit_product_prefix_drop_last
nodes.summary: Restrict an actual weighted-factor prefix to its predecessor interval.

nodes.name: euler_unit_product_prefix_entry
nodes.summary: The weighted-factor choice holds for every actual decoded entry, independently of beta encoding.

nodes.name: euler_unit_product_coprime
nodes.summary: The entire actual unit-weighted product is coprime to m; this is the proved cancellation premise.

nodes.name: euler_unit_factor_scaled_congruence
nodes.summary: A unit index contributes exactly one multiplier factor under the actual residue permutation.

nodes.name: euler_nonunit_factor_unchanged_congruence
nodes.summary: A nonunit index and its image both contribute one, so neither adds to the exponent.

nodes.name: euler_unit_scaled_prefix_drop_last
nodes.summary: Restrict the independently specified unit-scaled action to its predecessor prefix.

nodes.name: euler_unit_product_reindex_scale
nodes.summary: Actual beta composition along the multiplier permutation scales precisely the factors counted by Phi.

nodes.name: euler_coprime_weighted_product_cancel
nodes.summary: Cancel the proved coprime finite product in a balanced congruence, including the valid modulus-one case.

nodes.name: euler_unit_count_product_balance
nodes.summary: Induction on the actual independently counted zero-based unit prefix proves the exact power/product congruence; no Euler conclusion or unit-count oracle is a premise.

nodes.name: euler_coprime_totient_power_value
nodes.summary: For every positive modulus and any actual Phi and Pow values, construct all finite permutation/product witnesses and prove the Euler congruence by coprime cancellation.

nodes.name: euler_coprime_totient_power
nodes.summary: Construct the actual exponentiation witness for Euler's theorem at every positive modulus, without supplying a power, factor list, or permutation.

nodes.name: euler_modular_unit_totient_power
nodes.summary: The exact actual-inverse Unit graph suffices for a constructed Euler power; no prime-modulus restriction is introduced.

nodes.name: euler_theorem_for_units
nodes.summary: Full exact G014: m>1 and a genuinely witnessed modular unit and independently counted Phi imply an actual Pow witness congruent to one.

nodes.name: Lt
nodes.summary: Witness-defined strict order on natural numbers.

nodes.name: Dvd
nodes.summary: The natural number d divides n.

nodes.name: Coprime
nodes.summary: Every common divisor of a and b is one.

nodes.name: DivRem
nodes.summary: q and r are a quotient and a strict remainder for n by d.

nodes.name: ModEq
nodes.summary: Balanced-natural congruence modulo m.

nodes.name: BetaAt
nodes.summary: x is the bounded beta-decoded value at index i.

nodes.name: Product
nodes.summary: z is the product of a beta-coded prefix of length l.

nodes.name: Repeat
nodes.summary: The decoded prefix repeats a for l positions.

nodes.name: Pow
nodes.summary: z is the relational e-th power of a.

nodes.name: BoundedPrefix
nodes.summary: Every decoded entry below l is itself below l.

nodes.name: InjectivePrefix
nodes.summary: Equal decoded values below l have equal indices.

nodes.name: UnitBitPrefix
nodes.summary: The decoded bit at i<l is one exactly for Coprime(i,n), and zero otherwise. The interval starts at zero.

nodes.name: Sum
nodes.summary: z is the sum of a beta-coded prefix of length l.

nodes.name: UnitCount
nodes.summary: An actual beta sum counts the coprime residues in 0≤i<l. This auxiliary count is total even at modulus zero.

nodes.name: Phi
nodes.summary: Positive n and the actual count of canonical residues i<n coprime to n. Phi(1,1) counts residue zero; Phi excludes n=0.

nodes.name: SurjectivePrefix
nodes.summary: Every value below l occurs at an index below l.

nodes.name: PermutationPrefix
nodes.summary: An actual beta-coded bijection of the finite index interval [0,l), including all bounds, injectivity, and surjectivity.

nodes.name: Unit
nodes.summary: Exactly m>1 with a witnessed inverse b<m and a*b congruent to one. Unlike the old UnitResidue range, this expresses genuine invertibility at composite moduli.

nodes.name: CanonicalModularResidue
nodes.summary: A strictly bounded canonical natural residue r<m together with exact balanced congruence to a modulo m.

nodes.name: UnitMultiplierPrefix
nodes.summary: At every index i<l, the actual beta entry is the canonical residue of a*i. A bijection is constructed by theorem, not assumed in this graph.

nodes.name: UnitProductFactor
nodes.summary: The independently decided weighted factor is i when Coprime(i,m), and one otherwise. It contains neither Phi nor Euler's conclusion.

nodes.name: UnitProductPrefix
nodes.summary: Every actual beta entry in 0<=i<l satisfies UnitProductFactor at the same index. Product values are computed by the existing finite-product graph.

nodes.name: UnitScaledPrefix
nodes.summary: Two genuine beta prefixes are related by modular multiplication by a precisely at coprime indices, with the other factors unchanged.
